description: A wide 16:9 figure of one reasoning loop. Labels as plain text, no brackets. In the centre, three large rounded boxes arranged in a triangle and joined clockwise by thick curved sky-blue arrows: top box 'Thought' with a smaller line under it 'reason about what is known', bottom-right box 'Action' with a smaller line 'call one tool', bottom-left box 'Observation' with a smaller line 'read what came back'. The arrow from Observation returns to Thought. From the Thought box a separate straight green arrow leaves to the right to a box 'Final Answer' with a smaller line 'reply to Kavita'. On the far left, a box 'Kavita asks' with an arrow into Thought. Beside each loop box, a small grey example card in monospace text: next to Thought 'how long will the gaskets last? check the stock'; next to Action 'check_stock  item_code GSK-SIL-05L'; next to Observation 'free 66,000  cover 11 days'. Clean, airy, generous spacing.

A wide 16:9 timeline figure of one purchase job spread over several days. Labels as plain text, no brackets. A thin horizontal time axis across the lower middle with five tick labels: 'Day 1, morning', 'Day 1, afternoon', 'a minute later', 'Day 5', 'Day 8'. Above the axis, a row of rounded event boxes aligned to the ticks: at 'Day 1, morning' a sky-blue box 'Kavita asks; request PR/2026/04417 raised'; then a long grey dashed bar spanning to 'Day 1, afternoon' labelled 'paused: state saved, waiting for Rohit'; at 'Day 1, afternoon' a box 'Rohit approves in his inbox'; at 'a minute later' a sky-blue box 'harness reads Bahi, resumes: PO/2026/01182 created and released'; at 'Day 5' a box 'Neha records GRN/2026/30001, 12,000'; at 'Day 8' a green box 'GRN/2026/30002, 8,000: order closed'. Below the axis, a flat wide box spanning the full width labelled 'state store: messages, documents, waiting on whom' with small thin arrows up to each event box, showing it is saved and read at every step. Every tick label must be spelled exactly: Day 1, morning / Day 1, afternoon / a minute later / Day 5 / Day 8.
